svg.title: Prisma ORM Manifesto 2026: Open, Extensible, Collaborative
svg.desc: A scroll tile labeled Manifesto 2026 beside three tiles: a globe labeled Open, expanding arrows labeled Extensible, and a handshake labeled Collaborative, under the headline "Stewards, not gatekeepers". Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand: light paper surface, spectral prism wash, cyan accent.
